Package dev.ucomprotocol.ap2

Class Ap2MandateService

java.lang.Object
dev.ucomprotocol.ap2.Ap2MandateService
public class Ap2MandateService extends Object
Cryptographic service implementing the UCP 2026-08-25 AP2 Mandates extension (dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate).

Responsibilities:

  • Exporting the merchant's public signing key as an RFC 7517 JwkKey for /.well-known/ucp keys[].
  • Signing Checkout payloads using RFC 8785 JCS and detached JWS (ap2.merchant_authorization).
  • Verifying incoming SD-JWT+kb ap2.checkout_mandate credentials, expiration, embedded merchant authorization, and checkout scope consistency.

  • Constructor Details

    • Ap2MandateService

      public Ap2MandateService(String keyId, String algorithm, ECPrivateKey merchantPrivateKey, ECPublicKey merchantPublicKey, boolean requireCheckoutMandate, boolean verifyMandateSignature, boolean allowEmbeddedAgentJwk, List<JwkKey> trustedKeys)
      Creates an Ap2MandateService with explicit key material and policy flags.
      Parameters:
      keyId - merchant JWK kid
      algorithm - JWS ECDSA algorithm (ES256, ES384, or ES512)
      merchantPrivateKey - merchant EC private key for signing checkouts
      merchantPublicKey - merchant EC public key for verification and JWK publication
      requireCheckoutMandate - whether completeCheckout requires ap2.checkout_mandate
      verifyMandateSignature - whether to cryptographically verify mandate signatures
      allowEmbeddedAgentJwk - whether to accept self-contained agent JWKs in mandate headers or cnf.jwk claims
      trustedKeys - pre-configured trusted platform public JWKs

    • mintCheckoutMandate

      public String mintCheckoutMandate(Checkout signedCheckout, ECPrivateKey agentPrivateKey, ECPublicKey agentPublicKey, String agentKid, Duration ttl)
      Mints a spec-compliant SD-JWT+kb (dc+sd-jwt) checkout mandate over a merchant-signed Checkout. Useful for integration tests, sample storefronts, and platform/agent SDK workflows.
      Parameters:
      signedCheckout - checkout carrying ap2.merchant_authorization
      agentPrivateKey - platform or user EC private key
      agentPublicKey - platform or user EC public key
      agentKid - platform or user key ID
      ttl - validity duration of the mandate
      Returns:
      serialized <issuer-jwt>~<kb-jwt> checkout mandate string
